title: Patient identity and required content
acceptance_scenarios: Test valid/missing/incorrect identifiers, duplicates, permitted exceptions and required medical-form fields. Show required export/submission blocking and correct linkage; do not use real identity documents in demonstrations.
evidence_after_implementation: A11-identity-and-content-cases.csv; A11-validation-results.json; redacted form exhibit; form/identifier rule matrix and exception approval.
manual_acceptance: Registration/clinical owner witnesses patient linkage and signs form applicability. Refresh on forms, identity or mapping changes; merely displaying a code list does not prove complete medical-record compliance.
history_policy: Do not invent legacy consent times, rewrite existing clinical seals, or record mock authority responses as real acceptance.
implemented_controls: Identity-readiness view flags missing/nonstandard CCCD and conflicting identity values, permits documented review exceptions and avoids blocking ordinary care. Manual VNeID assertion is distinguished from government authentication.
remaining_actions: Verify identity ownership and approved exceptions. Custodian-approved clinical form/data-field inventory and destination-specific mandatory-content checks remain to be finalised; format checks do not establish authenticity.
